trigger: user explicitly names ChatGPT as the actor
user explicitly names AgentSwitchboard as the actor
user explicitly names the operator as the actor
a repository mutation can be performed by more than one actor and actor identity affects proof

steps.action: Resolve requestedActor from the current task. Explicit user wording outranks convenience. Use auto only when no actor is specified.
steps.gate: requestedActor is chatgpt, agentswitchboard, operator, or auto

steps.action: Run the actor-routing bind command before the mutation. For an explicit actor, selectedActor must equal requestedActor. Auto requires a recorded selection reason. Preserve the emitted BINDING_SHA256 outside the mutable binding file.
steps.gate: execution-actor-binding.json status is actor-bound and original binding SHA-256 is preserved

steps.action: Perform the operation through the selected actor only. Do not substitute another execution path because it is faster or already available.
steps.gate: operation returns actor-owned evidence or a concrete failure

steps.action: Run the verify command with actualActor, the actor-owned evidence reference, and the preserved --expected-binding-sha256. Verification validates the complete binding and rejects a changed digest.
steps.gate: execution-actor-receipt.json status is actor-verified, selectedActor equals actualActor, and bindingSha256 equals the preserved original digest

steps.action: Continue the owning workflow only after actor verification. If the selected actor cannot execute, preserve the binding and name the blocker; do not complete the task through another actor without a new explicit selection.

failureRecovery.mismatch: Fail closed, preserve the binding/receipt/report, do not claim the requested actor performed the operation.
failureRecovery.bindingDigestMismatch: Fail closed without producing an actor-verified receipt. Re-bind from the authoritative task instead of trusting the changed local binding.
failureRecovery.selectedActorUnavailable: Record blocker and dependency. A different actor requires a new explicit task decision or auto re-resolution when auto was originally selected.

proofCeiling: Actor-routing and pinned binding-digest continuity only; no hostile-host tamper resistance or underlying-operation proof.
